makemeahanzi.definition: to smile, to laugh; to giggle; to snicker

etymology.hint: A person 夭 with a big grin ⺮

characterDeckComponents.note: 夭 (a person leaning back) — the pose of someone laughing.
⺮ (bamboo-like strokes) — suggesting a wide grin, giving 笑 its meaning 'to laugh, smile.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to select, to elect, to choose; election

etymology.hint: walk

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk/move) — 选 relates to the process of selecting, as if moving through options
先 (xiān) gives a sound close to 选's reading xuǎn

makemeahanzi.definition: distant, remote, far; profound

etymology.hint: walk

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 远's meaning 'far, distant,' a long way to walk.
元 (yuán) gives a sound hint — 远 is pronounced yuǎn, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: son, child

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 兒, a picture of a child; compare 人

characterDeckComponents.note: 儿 (simplified from 兒) depicts a small child, drawn with a large head on a small body — a simple picture of youth.

makemeahanzi.definition: crazy, insane, mentally ill

etymology.hint: sickness

characterDeckComponents.note: 疒 (sickness) shows 疯 describes an afflicted state of mind.
风 (fēng) gives the exact sound of 疯.

makemeahanzi.definition: to change; to exchange, to swap, to trade

etymology.hint: hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 换 describes an action done by hand, such as swapping or exchanging.
奂 (huàn) gives the sound — an exact match with 换.

makemeahanzi.definition: to guess, to conjecture, to suppose; to feel

etymology.hint: dog

characterDeckComponents.note: 犭 (dog) shows 猜 relates to an animal sense used metaphorically for a hunch.
青 (qīng) gives a sound distantly related to cāi, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: couch (furniture that one can lie down on) (CL:張|张[zhang1])

makemeahanzi.definition: bed, couch; framework, chassis

etymology.hint: A house 广 made out of wood 木; 广 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 (shelter) suggests a piece of furniture kept indoors.
木 (wood) — early beds were built from wood, giving 床 its meaning.

makemeahanzi.definition: inside

etymology.hint: A man 人  entering a door 冂

characterDeckComponents.note: 冂 (an enclosure or doorway) — 内 pictures the space one enters.
人 (person) — a person entering an enclosure gave 内 its meaning 'inside' or 'within.'

makemeahanzi.definition: section, piece, division

etymology.hint: A hand using a chisel 殳 to cut stone

characterDeckComponents.note: 段 shows 殳 (a hand wielding a tool) cutting or shaping stone into pieces — giving 段 its meaning 'section, segment, paragraph.'

makemeahanzi.definition: command, decree, order; magistrate; to allow, to cause

etymology.hint: A person kneeling before a master 人

characterDeckComponents.note: 人 (a person) — kneeling before a figure of authority, the image of receiving an order that gave 令 its meaning 'command, order; to cause.'

makemeahanzi.definition: wine, spirits, liquor, alcohol

etymology.hint: A jar 酉 of wine 氵; 酉 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 酉 (a wine jar) — the vessel holding the drink
氵 (liquid) — the wine itself inside the jar

meanings: to make a bundle of money

makemeahanzi.definition: to issue, to dispatch, to send out; hair
song, lyrics; to sing, to chant

etymology.hint: breath

characterDeckComponents.note: 欠 (breath, an open mouth exhaling) — 歌 relates to the breath used in singing.
哥 (gē) gives the sound — an exact match with 歌's reading gē.

makemeahanzi.definition: to sing, to chant, to call; ditty, song

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 唱 describes singing, an action made with the mouth.
昌 (chāng) gives a sound close to chàng, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: learning, knowledge, science; to study, to go to school; -ology

etymology.hint: A building 冖 where children 子 study; ⺍ provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 冖 (a covering/roof) — represents the building or schoolhouse where learning happens.
子 (child) — 学 depicts children gathered to study.
⺍ is a small graphic element at the top of the character; its original pictorial meaning, if any, has been lost over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: measure word for vehicles

etymology.hint: Two 两 carts 车; 两 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — 辆 is used to count vehicles, one cart at a time.
两 (two) — its use here, counting out two carts, is the visual root of 辆's job as a measure word for vehicles.

makemeahanzi.definition: to find, to locate; to grope for, to search for

etymology.hint: hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 探 describes reaching out with the hand to search for something.

makemeahanzi.definition: to entertain, to receive, to treat; to delay, to wait

etymology.hint: To welcome someone arriving 彳 at the royal court 寺

characterDeckComponents.note: 彳 (a road/step) — someone arriving on the road
寺 (a court/hall) — the destination where the visitor is welcomed

makemeahanzi.definition: to collapse, to fall over; to lie down

etymology.hint: person

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 倒 relates to a person falling over
到 (dào) gives the sound — 倒 is also pronounced dào, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: rare beast; strange; elegant

etymology.hint: An animal standing straight; 亠 is the head

characterDeckComponents.note: 亠 — read as the head of an animal standing upright in this pictograph; the character was later reused for the unrelated meaning 'to leave, be apart from, distance.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to go, to depart; past, former

etymology.hint: step

characterDeckComponents.note: 彳 (step/walk) — relates directly to 往's meaning 'to go toward, in the direction of.'
王 (wáng) gives a sound hint — 往 is pronounced wǎng, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: ten thousand; innumerable
clique, faction, group, sect
frontier pass; to close, to shut; relation
sentence, clause, phrase, paragraph; stanza

etymology.hint: A phrase 勹 from the mouth 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 勹 (to wrap) — a phrase wrapped together as one unit
口 (mouth) — the words spoken to form the phrase

makemeahanzi.definition: five; surname

etymology.hint: Five elements (the cross with the extra stroke) between heaven 一 and earth 一

characterDeckComponents.note: 五 places an X-shaped cross between two horizontal lines representing heaven and earth — in traditional cosmology, this was linked to the five elements that fill the space between.

meanings: to stand by the side of

makemeahanzi.definition: nearby; to depend on, to lean on, to trust

etymology.hint: people back-to-back

characterDeckComponents.note: 非 (two things back-to-back) — 靠 relates to leaning against or relying on something
告 (gào) gives a sound distantly related to 靠's reading kào, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: life, lifetime; birth; growth

etymology.hint: A shoot 屮 growing in the soil 土

characterDeckComponents.note: 屮 (a young shoot) growing up out of 土 (earth/soil) — a picture of new life emerging from the ground.

makemeahanzi.definition: cause, reason; from

etymology.hint: Road 丨 leading to the farm 田

characterDeckComponents.note: 由 resembles 田 (a field) with a stem or road extending from it — pointing the way toward a source, which gave 由 its meaning of 'from' or 'cause.'

makemeahanzi.definition: man, boy; male; baron; surname

etymology.hint: Someone who can work 力 the farm 田

characterDeckComponents.note: 田 (field) — represents farmland.
力 (strength/effort) — someone strong enough to work the fields gave 男 its meaning 'male, man.'

makemeahanzi.definition: as, as if, like, such as, supposing

etymology.hint: A wife 女 following her husband's words 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — depicts a wife in the traditional image behind this character.
口 (mouth/words) — the wife following her husband's spoken words gave 如 its meaning of 'as, like, if.'

makemeahanzi.definition: finger, toe; to point, to indicate

etymology.hint: To point 旨 by hand 扌; 旨 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 指 relates to using the hand, specifically the fingers.
旨 (an aim, purpose) — combined with 扌 (hand), 指 came to mean 'finger' and 'to point,' aiming the hand at something.

makemeahanzi.definition: to reside at, to live in; place, locale; department

etymology.hint: To go somewhere 夂 and put down a flag 卜

characterDeckComponents.note: 夂 (a foot, to go) — 处 relates to arriving somewhere.
卜 (a mark or flag) — planting a marker after arriving gave 处 its meaning of 'a place' or 'to settle, deal with.'

meanings: within a definite time or space

makemeahanzi.definition: between, among; midpoint; space, place, locality

etymology.hint: The sun 日 shining through a doorway 门

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 (door/gate) — 间 pictures light passing through an entryway.
日 (sun) — sunlight shining through a gap in a doorway gave 间 its meaning of a space 'in between,' as in 中间 (in the middle) or 时间 (time, the space between moments).

makemeahanzi.definition: sediment, dregs; to waste, to spoil

etymology.hint: grain

characterDeckComponents.note: 米 (grain, rice) — 糟 originally named the dregs left over from making rice wine.
曹 (cáo) gives a sound close to zāo, sharing the same rhyme and tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to steal; burglar, thief

etymology.hint: person

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 偷 describes a person's action, stealing.
俞 (yú) gives a sound distantly related to tōu, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: chief, head, leader

etymology.hint: A deer's head 自 adorned with antlers 丷

characterDeckComponents.note: 自 here depicts a head (the character also independently means 'nose, self').
丷 depicts hair atop the head — 首 originally pictured a head with hair, giving its meaning 'head, chief, first.'

meanings: (bound form) husky (dog) (abbr. for 哈士奇[ha1 shi4 qi2])

makemeahanzi.definition: the sound of laughter

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 哈 is the sound made by the mouth while laughing
合 (hé) gives a sound related to 哈's reading hā, from an older, closer pronunciation link

makemeahanzi.definition: to wake up, to startle; to sober up

etymology.hint: wine

characterDeckComponents.note: 酉 (wine jar) — 醒 originally described sobering up from drink, extending to 'to wake up.'
星 (xīng) gives a sound close to xǐng, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to divide, to allocate; fraction; small unit of time or other quantity

etymology.hint: Pieces 八 being further subdivided with a knife 刀

characterDeckComponents.note: 八 (to divide/split apart) — represents something already split into parts.
刀 (knife) — a knife cutting already-divided pieces further, giving 分 its meaning 'to divide, to separate.'

makemeahanzi.definition: department, ministry; division, unit; part, section

etymology.hint: place

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a variant of 邑, meaning place/settlement) — 部 relates to a division, section, or department.
咅 supplies the sound for 部 (bù); it belongs to the same phonetic family as related characters like 倍 (bèi) and 培 (péi).

makemeahanzi.definition: same, similar; together with, alike

etymology.hint: Sharing a common 凡 tongue 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 凡 (common/ordinary) — suggests something shared or held in common.
口 (mouth) — sharing a common mouth/voice with others gave 同 its meaning of 'same, together.'

makemeahanzi.definition: half; semi-, incomplete

etymology.hint: A cow 牛 splitting 丷 wood in half

characterDeckComponents.note: 牛 (ox/cow) — cattle were used to help split or divide things such as firewood.
丷 depicts two small pieces splitting apart — giving 半 its meaning 'half.'

makemeahanzi.definition: few, little; less; inadequate

etymology.hint: Grains of sand; 小 provides the pronunciation and meaning

characterDeckComponents.note: 少 depicts a few small dots or grains, like scattered sand — a simple picture of a small quantity, giving the meaning 'few' or 'little.'

meanings: used in 提防[di1 fang5] and 提溜[di1 liu5]

makemeahanzi.definition: to hold in the hand; to lift, to raise

etymology.hint: hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 提 relates to lifting or carrying something by hand.
是 (shì) gives a hint of the sound — 提 is pronounced tí, a connection that has shifted over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: this, thus, such; emphatic particle; used in transliterations
to set up; to manage, to run; to deal with, to handle

etymology.hint: strength

characterDeckComponents.note: 力 (strength) — relates to 办's meaning 'to handle, manage, do,' something accomplished through effort.
八 (bā) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from bàn.

makemeahanzi.definition: school, education

etymology.hint: script

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (a hand with a stick) — 教 relates to instructing or disciplining, the traditional action of teaching.
孝 (xiào) gives a hint of the sound — 教 is pronounced jiào, a connection that has shifted somewhat.

makemeahanzi.definition: to add to, to increase, to augment

etymology.hint: Supporting a cause with the strength 力 of one's words 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 力 (strength) — 加 pictures adding one's effort to a cause.
口 (mouth, words) — combining strength with words of support gave 加 its meaning 'to add' or 'to increase.'
